title: Go Ballooning
specs: Complete an indemnity form prior to flying
Not be under the influence of drugs or alcohol during the flight
Check with medical practitioner if you have a pre-existing medical condition
blurb: Guests take hot air balloon flights to create unforgettable moments. The company has maintained a 100% safety rating since 1984. Flights depend on suitable weather and mechanical conditions.
extraNote: Flights may be cancelled due to unsuitable weather or mechanical issues · No changes permitted within 48 hours prior to flight · No refunds or rescheduling if passenger cancels within 48 hours of flight · No refunds for no-shows; rebooking fee may be considered · Gift vouchers are non-refundable and valid for three years
